name: operant
description: Operant — Extensión multi-navegador con Native Messaging, media scraping, ffmpeg, yt-dlp y base para agentes de navegación.

scripts.test:unit: node --test tests/unit/filename.test.js tests/unit/icons.test.js tests/unit/media-core.test.js tests/unit/hls-fast.test.js tests/unit/extension-id.test.js tests/unit/native-protocol.test.js tests/unit/privacy-claims.test.js tests/unit/packaging.test.js
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run check:manifest && npm run check:secrets && npm run key:verify && node scripts/check-version.mjs
scripts.host:build: cargo build --release --manifest-path native-host-rs/Cargo.toml && powershell -Command Copy-Item native-host-rs/target/release/operant-host.exe native-host/operant-host.exe -Force
scripts.host:lint: cargo fmt --manifest-path native-host-rs/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path native-host-rs/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
